planets.name: TOI-778 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-778 with a 4.63-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-778 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-778. Its orbit and size follow Clark et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
